allow_instructions: User requests like commit / push / merge / deploy on this repo authorize git push to main and Cloudflare Workers deploy (wrangler or Workers Builds) without repeated confirmations in the same session.
Allow npm test, node --test, and reading production version.json after deploy.
block_instructions: Do not force-push, hard-reset, or delete remote branches unless the user names that exact destructive action.
Do not commit .env/secrets or bulk GIS data outside the stated code change.
